title: ArdoTech / Wine & AI — Working Notes
summary: This paper outlines plans for a UK-based company that applies AI/ML expertise to the wine industry, which the author sees as technologically underserved. The proposed structure involves a broad legal entity name "ArdoTech Ltd" that can handle general data science consulting, paired with wine-specific trading names like "ArdoTech Wine Analytics" for targeted wine industry work. The author favors this naming approach because it leverages the Basque word "ardo" (wine) while maintaining flexibility to pivot beyond wine into other AI/ML applications.
